summary: No Policy edit was found that makes acceptance/integration run a subset or split the five pytest checks into multiple executions; evidence per check ID and failure propagation are correct under the shared execution (2834 passed, 1 skipped, 1083.47 s). Condition: the code does not pin the 1200 s timeout required by the spec, so a uniform different timeout is accepted; also pin argv[0] to {python}, clarify quickstart --check wording. Out-of-scope chapter-11 doc and CHANGELOG are not updated; 1200 s headroom is about 10% and V2/Linux timing is unmeasured.

findings.title: Full-suite timeout not pinned to 1200 s; uniform non-1200 timeout passes parsing contrary to spec
argv[0] of pytest checks is not pinned to {python}
Quickstart --check wording reads as if every partial check runs the full suite
Out-of-scope chapter-11 doc still describes fixed subdirectory commands; CHANGELOG lacks a Policy 2.4.0 entry
1083 s against the 1200 s budget leaves about 10% headroom; V2 and Linux CI timing unmeasured
